key_findings: Review: BNST neurons are predominantly GABAergic with diverse neuropeptide coexpression (CRF, Ucn, PACAP, CGRP, Sst and others).
BNSTov CRF/CRFR1 signaling is anxiogenic whereas Ucn3/CRFR2 signaling is anxiolytic/coping-related.
